report:
Liver, right lobe, biopsy

Sections show two cores of liver measuring 24 mm in aggregate length, with 13 portal tracts. There is macrovesicular steatosis involving about 40% of the parenchyma. There are a few ballooned hepatocytes. There is moderate lobular inflammation. Mallory-Denk bodies are seen. NAS components: steatosis 2, lobular inflammation 2 and ballooning 1. Masson trichrome stain shows zone 3 perisinusoidal and portal or periportal fibrosis.

LIVER, right lobe, biopsy - STEATOHEPATITIS with PERISINUSOIDAL AND PERIPORTAL FIBROSIS (NAS 5/8; NASH CRN stage 2), in keeping with METABOLIC DYSFUNCTION-ASSOCIATED STEATOHEPATITIS (MASH)
